title: Admin API: read-only operational endpoints
description: Adds read-only REST API endpoints for a forum's operational state - a summary of the server error log, an inventory of installed add-ons, the state of cron entries and the job queue, and which options and config.php settings are set, without their values. A separately scoped endpoint returns individual error log entries. Each endpoint requires an administrator's own API key and that administrator's admin permission; super user keys are refused.
